_comment: Reviewed counties for club and event cities (#159, owner decision Q5; plan v2 MF2). An entry gives the county of a city that is not a census place, and may override the computed county of one that is. Every countyGeoid must exist in public/data/zip-places.json with that countyName and state; an entry equal to the computed county is redundant. A bad entry is left out, reported, and fails `python archive.py --search-data --check`. Each entry carries its evidence.

cities.evidence: Woodland Hills is a district of the City of Los Angeles, not a census place (club 82, LAFC So Cal). Its own zips, 91364 and 91367, are in the census place Los Angeles (0644000), Los Angeles County, in the census table. PR 1's judged county list puts it in Los Angeles County. Club 82's home field at Oak Park (91377, Ventura County) is deliberately not the evidence.

Westampton Township is a county subdivision, not a census place (club 2628). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 08060 (239 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in Burlington County; 08060 is the Westampton Sports Complex's own zip.

Elma is a town (county subdivision); the census place is Elma Center (club 343). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 14059 (319 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in Erie County; 14059 is Elma's own zip.

Lancaster is a town (county subdivision); the census place is South Lancaster (club 52). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 01523 (517 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in Worcester County; 01523 is Lancaster's own zip.

There is no census place named St. Johns in Florida in 2020 (club 1353). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 32259 (303 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in St. Johns County; 32259 is the St. Johns and Fruit Cove area's own zip.

Greenbrae is unincorporated and not a census place (club 1585). The club's main home field is at zip 94904 (201 home games in the archive), shared by Greenbrae and Kentfield, which the census table puts in Marin County; its other home zips (94901, 94939) are in Marin County too.

Farmington is a town (county subdivision), not a census place (club 431). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 06032 (309 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in Hartford County; 06032 is Farmington's own zip.

Bethany is a town (county subdivision), not a census place (club 31). Not a census place. The club's main home field is at zip 06524 (246 home games in the archive), which the census table puts in New Haven County (2020 counties; Connecticut's 2022 planning regions are not in the 2020 files); 06524 is Bethany's own zip.

Hamilton Township is a county subdivision, not a census place (club 3313, PDA White (Shore)). The 2020 census county-subdivision record "Hamilton township, Mercer County, New Jersey" gives Mercer County (owner decision Q2, #162, 2026-10-21; owner decision Q1 chose Mercer). New Jersey's other Hamilton Township is in Atlantic County and is postally Mays Landing (08330); the postal name "Hamilton, NJ" belongs to 08610, 08619, 08620, 08690 and 08691, which the census table puts in Mercer County with the CDPs White Horse, Mercerville, Yardville and Hamilton Square. The club's home fields (08873 Somerset, 07724 Monmouth, 08753 Ocean, 08060 Burlington) are deliberately not the evidence.

Shelby Charter Township is a county subdivision, not a census place (club 1713, Nationals). The 2020 census county-subdivision record "Shelby charter township, Macomb County, Michigan" gives Macomb County (owner decision Q2, #162, 2026-10-21). Its zips 48315, 48316 and 48317 are in Macomb County in the census table. The census place Shelby (2672840) is a village in Oceana County, a different place, and "Shelby Twp" never matches it. The club's home fields (48309 Oakland County, 48236 Wayne County) are deliberately not the evidence.

Auburn is a town (county subdivision), not a census place (club 94, Scorpions SC). The 2020 census county-subdivision record "Auburn town, Worcester County, Massachusetts" gives Worcester County (owner decision Q2, #162, 2026-10-21). Its zip 01501 is in Worcester County, with no census place, in the census table. The club's home fields (02780 Bristol, 02053 Norfolk, 01523 Worcester) are deliberately not the evidence.

Baldwin is an unincorporated community, neither a census place nor a county subdivision (club 3405, Pipeline SC). USPS "ZIP Code by City and State" gives 21013 for Baldwin, MD (owner decision Q2, #162, 2026-10-21), and the census table puts 21013 in Baltimore County (24005), not Baltimore city (24510); its area-rule place is a sliver of Fallston (Harford County), so no place is set. The club's home fields are Mercy High School at 21239 (Baltimore city, 202 home games at 12182be0) and Notre Dame Preparatory School at 21286 (Baltimore County, 43).
